description: One-replica, two-hour EdgeBench VLIW run using Claude Code that requests the glm-5.1 identifier with the official adaptive-thinking defaults; verify the actual served model from transcript response metadata.

protocol_override_reasons.agent: the run selects the native Claude Code agent used by the official GLM-5.1 setting
protocol_override_reasons.backend: the local run uses Docker instead of the official Kubernetes backend
protocol_override_reasons.model: the run requests the glm-5.1 identifier through the Z.AI Anthropic-compatible API; the actual served model must be verified from transcript message.model metadata
protocol_override_reasons.timeout: the requested run uses a two-hour task budget
protocol_override_reasons.attempts_per_task: the run uses one trajectory rather than three paper trajectories
protocol_override_reasons.cell_concurrency: the local controller runs one task-method cell at a time
protocol_override_reasons.judge_concurrency: the local shared Judge serializes ephemeral Judge containers
